title_en: Commentary on al-Mughnī al-Mufīd — Tape One
body_ar:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين.

أما بعد فهذا كتاب التوحيد الذي هو حق الله على العبيد للعلامة الشيخ محمد بن عبد الوهاب بن سليمان التميمي النجدي، وهو يتضمن توحيد العبادة لله سبحانه وتعالى، وهو أحد أنواع التوحيد وما يتصل به من الأمور التي هي من تمامه،
body_en:
In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. All praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds, and I ask God to bless and grant peace to the one who was sent as a mercy to all the worlds, and to his family, his Companions, and all who follow his guidance and keep to his sunnah until the Day of Judgement.

To proceed: this is Kitāb al-Tawḥīd alladhī huwa ḥaqq Allāh ʿalā al-ʿabīd — 'The Book of Divine Oneness, which is God's Right over His Servants' — by the erudite scholar Shaykh Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab ibn Sulayman al-Tamimi al-Najdi. It sets out the devoting of worship to God alone, glorified and exalted, which is one of the categories of the oneness of God (tawḥīd), together with the connected matters that belong to its completion,

flags.context: The title of the series, appearing in the title of articles 502–516.
options: al-Mughnī al-Mufīd (left untranslated as a work title)
The Sheikh's commentary series on Kitāb al-Tawḥīd
flags.note: Article 516 shows the series expounds Kitāb al-Tawḥīd of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab, and article 508 quotes the base text in verse, so al-Mughnī al-Mufīd appears to be a versification (naẓm) of that book rather than a separate work by the Sheikh. The Sheikh's office should confirm the work and its author before the title is translated or expanded anywhere in the corpus; it has been left untranslated for now.

translator_notes: The published page carries only the opening excerpt of this lecture/sermon; the Arabic breaks off mid-sentence and the full text is offered on the site as a downloadable Word document. The English ends exactly where the Arabic ends. Nothing has been supplied to complete it.

This page belongs to the Sheikh's tape series on Kitāb al-Tawḥīd of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab, identified in article 516, the first tape of the series. Passages in quotation marks are the base text being commented on; the unquoted text is the Sheikh's own commentary. The distinction is load-bearing and has been preserved.
This is the key page for the whole series: it names the work being expounded as Kitāb al-Tawḥīd of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab. Articles 502–516 should be linked as one series on the strength of it.
The book's Arabic title has been transliterated and then given in English, since it is a work title and not a phrase of the Sheikh's own prose.
توحيد العبادة is rendered 'the devoting of worship to God alone' rather than transliterated, to keep the English readable; the Arabic remains in the bilingual pane.
